quizName:
Sign Test
									  					
									  														  					Check how well you know road signs.

questions.question: What does this sign show?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that an intersection with a crossing road is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs prepare drivers for upcoming road conditions and hazards. They are usually yellow with black markings. This sign tells drivers that an intersection is coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Construction zones are dangerous for both drivers and construction workers. Orange signs warn drivers to be careful in construction areas. This sign tells drivers that construction is starting ahead.

questions.question: The driver's left arm and hand point downward. What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When a driver's left arm and hand point downward, they are signaling that they will stop. Adjust your driving if you are following this driver.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There are bumps in the road.

questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that the divided highway ends ahead.

questions.question: When you see a yield sign at an intersection, what should you do?

options.text: Always stop before entering the intersection.
Only yield to traffic on your right.
Only yield to traffic on your left.
Slow down and let other traffic go first.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let other traffic go first.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means you must slow down and let other traffic go first before you enter the intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Don't park on the right side of the street.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through it means the action shown is not allowed. In this case, right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Follow the detour to the right.
Get ready to enter a one-way street.
Stay on the main highway if you can.
Follow the detour to the right only if convenient.

questions.correctAnswerText: Follow the detour to the right.
questions.explanation: Construction signs are orange with black lettering. Detour signs show drivers an alternate route to avoid blocked roads caused by construction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You cannot park here at any time.

questions.correctAnswerText: You cannot park here at any time.
questions.explanation: Regulation signs control traffic and tell drivers the rules they must follow. This sign means parking is not allowed at any time in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A series of curves is ahead.
The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when it rains or is wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that traffic only moves in one direction. You must drive in the direction shown by the arrow.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means a divided highway is coming. The road will split into two separate one-way roads. Stay in the right lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash means something is not allowed. You cannot make a U-turn where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Don't drink if you are going to drive.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when it is wet. Slow down and be careful.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign marks a shared center lane. Cars from both directions can use it only to turn left. Do not use this lane for regular driving.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign says you cannot make a U-turn. Do not turn around where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You should drive with the flow of traffic.
Limit your speed for the next 50 miles.
Speed limits are enforced for the next 50 miles.
The speed limit is 50 miles per hour.

questions.correctAnswerText: The speed limit is 50 miles per hour.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the maximum speed you are allowed to drive. Do not go faster than 50 miles per hour.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a stop sign is coming. Slow down and be ready to stop completely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you to drive carefully when the road is wet. The road can become slippery in wet conditions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a lane is ending. Be ready to merge safely with other traffic.

questions.question: What is the correct order of traffic lights from top to bottom?
questions.explanation: Red is always at the top and green at the bottom on vertical traffic lights. On horizontal lights, red is always on the left and green on the right.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic light is ahead. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.
Come to a complete stop before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: If you pass these signs, you are going the wrong way and risk a head-on collision. Turn around carefully.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves right. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Divided highway begins. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Merge. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Winding road ahead. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road curves to the right ahead. Slow down to the safe speed shown on the sign (in this case, 35 mph).

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means an intersection is coming up. Watch carefully for traffic crossing your path.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and tell you about road hazards ahead. This sign warns of a sharp turn coming up. Reduce your speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign alerts drivers that buggies may be ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Construction workers on or near the roadway.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign means pedestrians may be crossing the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
The road ahead winds a series of turns or curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet. In wet conditions, slow down, avoid sudden braking or turns, and increase your distance from the vehicle ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
Lane reduction; the left lane ends soon.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the right lane will end soon.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs mean you must stop. Look for traffic and yield the right-of-way. You can go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash means something is not allowed. This sign says right turns are not permitted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that parking is not allowed here.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to upcoming hazards. This sign tells you a detour is coming in 1,000 feet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Three-sided signs mean slow down at the intersection. Be ready to stop and let other drivers or pedestrians go first. You can go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign prevent?

options.text: Entrances from the wrong direction on one-way streets and expressway ramps.

questions.correctAnswerText: Entrances from the wrong direction on one-way streets and expressway ramps.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic only moves one way. Do not enter from the wrong direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow background and black markings. This sign alerts you that a traffic light is coming. Be ready for a red or yellow light.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must drive slowly and sound your horn.
You are entering a school's parking lot.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you a school zone is coming. Slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to stay on the right side of the divider.

questions.question: What should you do if you see this sign above your lane?

options.text: You can continue through the interchange or exit the freeway from your lane.
You can stay in your lane and continue through the interchange.
You must exit the freeway if you stay in your current lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must exit the freeway if you stay in your current lane.
questions.explanation: An "Exit only" sign means your lane will leave the freeway. You have two choices: change lanes to continue on the freeway, or stay in your lane and exit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road curves sharply to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Five-sided signs warn you about schools. Watch for children and pedestrians in the area. This sign means a school is nearby.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The left lane must turn left.
You can turn left only on a green arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane must turn left.
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers in the left lane they must turn left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This warning sign tells you to watch for people crossing the street.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you of a steep hill ahead. Slow down to avoid brake problems and collisions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the bridge or overpass ahead is low. Do not go under it if your vehicle is taller than the height shown.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows the direction you must drive on a one-way street.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is approaching.
Look both ways as you cross the intersection.
Always come to a full stop at the intersection.
Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.
questions.explanation: Slow down at a yield sign. Be ready to stop if traffic or pedestrians are in the intersection. You must stop if needed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs warn you about construction zones. This sign tells you that penalties for bad driving are doubled in work zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is an object on the roadway.
Traffic is coming from the right.
The road curves sharply to the left.
There is a merge point ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves sharply to the left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows a sharp curve in the direction of the arrow. In this case, the road curves to the left. You may see several of these signs placed along the curve.

questions.question: What do these signs indicate?
questions.explanation: These are warning signs with yellow background and black markings. They warn drivers about objects or areas that could be dangerous and should be avoided.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a 35 mph speed zone after the curve.
You must drive at least 35 mph around the curve.
Curve ahead. Speeds of 35 mph or slower are recommended.
Stay in the right lane if you are not driving over 35 mph.

questions.correctAnswerText: Curve ahead. Speeds of 35 mph or slower are recommended.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road curves ahead in the direction of the arrow. The sign recommends driving at 35 mph or slower through the curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a warning sign with a yellow background and black markings. It warns drivers that a bridge with narrow lanes is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means right turns are not allowed. Do not turn right at an intersection where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and be ready to stop if cars are coming.
Come to a full stop, then go when it is safe.
Go through the intersection carefully without always stopping.
Stop only for traffic on a crossing road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop, then go when it is safe.
questions.explanation: A stop sign requires you to come to a complete stop. You must let vehicles and pedestrians in or near the intersection pass. Then you can go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that a four-way intersection is coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign indicate?

options.text: Trucks are not allowed on the upcoming hill.
Trucks are on the upcoming hill.

questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that a steep hill or downgrade is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is for vehicles with a certain number of passengers.
Certain turns are allowed from certain lanes.
Both lanes must merge smoothly together.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is for vehicles with a certain number of passengers.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane. These lanes are for buses and vehicles with a driver plus one or more passengers, as shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep downhill grade is ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: This sign shows where bicycles cross or ride. Drive carefully in this area because bicycles may cross the road or ride next to traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns you of low clearance ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs show traffic rules that drivers must follow. This sign means large trucks cannot go past this point.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Be prepared for a sharp left turn ahead.
Watch for people crossing your path.
Take a detour to avoid dangerous driving conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Take a detour to avoid dangerous driving conditions.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road ahead is closed or dangerous due to work. Follow the detour route shown.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead has many curves and turns.

questions.question: You see a "Merging traffic" sign on the freeway. What should you do?

options.text: Always remain at your present speed.
Speed up to avoid congesting traffic.
Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.
questions.explanation: Make room for vehicles merging into your lane. If it is safe and the lane next to you is empty, move over to let them in.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
Two lanes of traffic moving in opposite directions are about to merge.

questions.correctAnswerText: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the bridge or overpass ahead is lower than the height shown. Do not pass under it if your vehicle is taller than the stated height.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a school crossing is coming up ahead.

questions.question: This is a ____ sign.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign is a "Yield" sign. Slow down and check for traffic. Let pedestrians and other vehicles go first. Stop only if needed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows that there are multiple lanes for left turns. Drivers in the far left lane must turn left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow background and black markings. This sign warns you that wet roads may be slippery and harder to control.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
Traffic in the lane must turn in the direction of the arrow.
Lanes are reserved for buses and vehicles with a driver and one or more passengers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved for people with disabled parking permits.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn left or right.
You are approaching a T intersection.
The road that you are on intersects with a divided highway.
You are on an overpass above a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road that you are on intersects with a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign means your road crosses a divided highway. A divided highway has two one-way roads separated by a median or barrier.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers about construction zones. This sign tells you that construction ahead will change your normal route. Expect a different driving path.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means when turning left on a green light, you must yield to oncoming traffic. Complete your turn only when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead is closed to traffic.
The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers of work zones. This sign tells you that maintenance is happening ahead. Slow down and be very careful.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that cattle may cross the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that lanes are shifting ahead. Follow the new lane direction.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a pedestrian crossing ahead. Watch for people in the crosswalk. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means the road ahead is divided. Stay to the right of the divider or median.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs prepare you for road hazards. They are yellow with black markings. This sign alerts you that a curve is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign is posted at the end of one-way streets. It warns you not to enter the road from the wrong direction. Stop and turn around if you see this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs prepare you for road hazards. They are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you a playground is near. Watch for children near the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There are trucks hauling gravel ahead.
The highway ahead is under construction.
The highway ahead is covered with loose gravel.
The highway ahead has been sanded for icy conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead is covered with loose gravel.
questions.explanation: Warning signs alert you to hazards ahead. They are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you the road ahead has loose gravel. Drive carefully because your tires will have less grip.

questions.question: What does a yellow and black diamond-shaped sign mean?

options.text: It warns you about conditions on or near the road.
It helps you find cities and towns ahead.
It tells you about traffic laws.
It tells you about road construction ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: It warns you about conditions on or near the road.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black symbols on a yellow background. They tell you about hazards on or near the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the road ahead curves sharply to the right and then sharply to the left.

questions.question: What does this black and yellow sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is for one-way traffic only.
There is a detour to the right due to roadwork.
Slow down because the road ahead changes direction sharply.
There is a crossroad to your right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down because the road ahead changes direction sharply.
questions.explanation: This sign means the road ahead turns sharply in one direction. Slow down before you reach this turn, just as you would at an intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane ends or roadway narrows ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane ends or roadway narrows ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. This sign warns you that a lane is ending or the road is getting narrower ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that from this lane, you can either turn right or continue straight ahead at the intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A roundabout is coming up. Enter it slowly and let traffic already in the roundabout go first.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic is coming toward you from the opposite direction ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This orange construction sign warns you that someone ahead will be directing traffic. Follow their directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that farm machinery may be on the road ahead.

questions.question: This sign shows one type of:
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a T intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this stop sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.
Drive with caution and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop and make sure no cars or pedestrians are in your way before you go.

questions.question: At a school crossing sign, you should:

options.text: Always stop, even if there is no stop sign.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always honk your horn when you see children.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Always let pedestrians cross first. Pay close attention to people crossing the street or about to cross at intersections.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you that the shoulder of the road ahead is lower than the paved road.

questions.question: What can you do from the center turn lane?
questions.explanation: This lane is only for making left turns. You cannot use it to pass other cars or to drive straight through.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The minimum speed limit is 40 mph.
Fines are doubled in work zones.
An extra lane is being added.

questions.correctAnswerText: The minimum speed limit is 40 mph.
questions.explanation: This is a regulation sign. It tells you the minimum speed you must drive. You cannot drive slower than the speed shown on this sign.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You may turn right only after making a complete stop.

questions.explanation: This is a regulation sign that shows a rule you must obey. Right turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks are allowed on the narrow bridge ahead.
The bridge ahead allows only one direction of traffic.
Only one car can cross the bridge at a time.
The bridge ahead may be too narrow to pass a truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge ahead may be too narrow to pass a truck.
questions.explanation: This is a warning sign (yellow with black markings). It warns you that a narrow bridge is ahead. You may not have enough space to pass or meet a truck. Be careful and slow down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: An extra lane is being added.

questions.explanation: This is a warning sign (yellow with black markings). It warns you that traffic may be coming from the opposite direction ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulation sign that shows a rule you must obey. Left turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic is merging in from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is merging in from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that traffic from the right side will be joining your lane ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is an orange construction sign. It warns you that construction work is ahead and the right lane will be closed. Drive carefully through the construction zone.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Stay on the side the arrow points to.
You may drive in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay on the side the arrow points to.
questions.explanation: This is a "Keep right" sign. It tells you that an obstacle (like a median or island) is ahead. Drive on the side shown by the arrow to avoid it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a warning sign (yellow with black markings). It warns you that a yield sign is coming up. Be ready to slow down and yield to other drivers or pedestrians.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This round sign warns you that a railroad crossing is ahead. Watch for trains and be ready to stop if you see one coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They warn drivers about upcoming dangers. This sign tells you that the divided highway is ending.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare drivers for upcoming road dangers. This sign alerts you that deer may cross the road in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare drivers for upcoming road dangers. This sign tells you that the road will become a divided highway soon.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is posted at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It tells you that you cannot drive in your current direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs control traffic speed and movement. They show rules that drivers must follow. Where this sign is posted, U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare drivers for upcoming road dangers. This sign warns you that a traffic signal is ahead. Be ready for red lights, yellow lights, and cross traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Five-sided signs mean a school is nearby. Drivers should watch for children and pedestrians on or near the road. This sign marks a school crossing. You must obey any crossing guard instructions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They warn drivers about upcoming dangers. This sign tells you that a steep hill is ahead. Slow down to drive safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Construction zones are dangerous for drivers and workers. Orange construction signs warn drivers to be careful in these areas. This sign directs you to take a detour when road work changes the normal route.

questions.question: A sign with this shape and color is a ____ sign.
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped warning signs only mark no passing zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for workers on or near the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for workers on or near the road.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that workers are on or near the road. Drive slowly and carefully in work zones.

questions.question: A driver's left arm and hand are extended upward. What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When a driver's left arm and hand point upward, they are signaling a right turn. Adjust your driving if you see this signal.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you that traffic may enter from a side road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a low ground railroad crossing. The road slopes steeply at the tracks, and the bottom of low vehicles may drag or get stuck.

questions.question: If you see this sign, what should you do?

options.text: You may pass a slow vehicle if you do it quickly.
You may pass if you know the road.
You may pass only at night.

questions.explanation: Regulatory signs are white with black markings. You must obey all regulatory signs. This sign means passing is not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs tell drivers rules they must follow. This sign means you should not drive into the intersection if traffic will block it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs tell drivers rules they must follow. This sign means right turns are not permitted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs tell drivers rules they must follow. This sign marks reserved parking spaces for vehicles with handicap permits, tags, or license plates.

questions.question: What does this sign show?

options.text: The safest speed for a residential area.
The safest speed for an expressway exit.
The safest speed for an expressway entrance.
The safest speed for a work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The safest speed for an expressway exit.
questions.explanation: This speed advisory sign shows the safest speed for a highway exit. In this example, the safe speed is 30 mph.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A bike repair shop is ahead.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that bicycles may be on or near the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are entering a one-way street in the wrong direction.
Do not drive in this lane.
Drivers turning left on green must yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drivers turning left on green must yield to oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign works with traffic lights. It tells drivers that left-turning traffic does not have the right-of-way. Wait for oncoming traffic to clear before turning.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road turns sharply right, then left.
The road turns sharply left, then right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road turns sharply right, then left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers the parking rules for this area. You may park for a maximum of two hours during the posted times.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must travel at this exact speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum speed on this road is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This is a speed limit sign. It shows the highest legal speed you may drive on this road. In bad weather like rain, snow, or ice, you may need to drive slower than the posted limit.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and let trains pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let trains pass.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a railroad crossing ahead. Always slow down at railroad crossings. Trains cannot stop for cars, so you must wait for them to pass before crossing the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed at this location.

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
Slow down without coming to a complete stop.

Slow down and check for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.

questions.question: If you see this sign, you:

options.text: Should maintain your vehicle's speed until you enter the reduced speed zone.

Should not slow down because traffic will start to back up.

questions.explanation: This sign tells you to slow down. The speed limit will change at the next sign.

options.text: No traffic is allowed in this lane.

options.text: The exact speed you must drive to avoid a ticket.

The maximum safe speed in all conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed under good road and weather conditions.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the maximum legal speed for that road. You may need to drive slower than the limit if conditions are poor. Always adjust your speed for weather and road conditions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

questions.question: What is the main danger shown by this sign?

options.text: Your headlights will be misaligned because one side of your car will be higher.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that the shoulder is lower than the road. If your wheel drops off the road, do not brake hard or turn sharply. This can cause you to lose control. Gently steer back onto the road.
